baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition opened by حُرِّمَتْ is closed by the compelled-hunger clause, غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِإِثْمٍ, and غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A protected boundary governs ordinary choice, while necessity suspends its material demand only when survival pressure is real and the eater is not leaning toward transgression. Forgiveness and mercy preserve the person when the boundary cannot be materially maintained.

activation_trace.role: Literal prohibition supplies the protected boundary that the closing exception calibrates.
Necessity and compulsion supply the external pressure that changes the rule's application.
An empty belly makes the pressure bodily and survival-directed rather than merely convenient.
Deliberate leaning away from the right course supplies the intention test that limits the exception.
Protective covering of fault supplies relief from the consequence of compelled breach.
Tender mercy makes preservation of the pressured eater part of the legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A list of forbidden foods followed by a general emergency exception.
changed_reading.after: A calibrated boundary system that distinguishes chosen deviation from compelled survival and protects the subject when material compliance becomes impossible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from carrion and violent deaths through predator-eating, timely slaughter, alien dedication, altar, and divining arrows.
baseline_models.mechanism: The list tests a food's passage into admissibility across biological condition, causal handling, ritual affiliation, and allocation. Uncontrolled death or consumption breaks the passage; completed slaughter can rescue it before that break becomes final, while alien dedication and chance-assigned shares misdirect accountable agency.

activation_trace.role: Carrion without slaughter supplies the basic failed transition from animal life to admissible food.
Prey prepared for another eater marks a chain already claimed by uncontrolled predation.
The predatory animal supplies the nonhuman consumer whose eating can terminate human-directed handling.
Completion of slaughter supplies the narrow rescue operation before the food transition is lost.
The literal throat-cut supplies accountable human processing rather than accidental death.
The branch image of group belonging makes the voiced dedication an affiliation mark within provenance.
Difference and exclusion distinguish both alien dedication and the non-deviating necessity case.
A stone erected for worship or sacrifice fixes the processing act to a rival ritual station.
A mind partitioned among alternatives makes divinatory allocation the final failure of accountable direction.

changed_reading.before: A heterogeneous catalogue of food taboos followed by a separate ban on divination.
changed_reading.after: A chain-of-admissibility test asking how matter died, who completed or consumed it, where it was affiliated, and whether allocation remained accountable rather than chance-directed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ... مِن دِينِكُمْ, فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ, and the completion, favor, approval, and repeated دِين clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Completion stabilizes an authority structure: obedience and judgment no longer take their direction from hostile pressure. The paired fear command transfers governing awe, while approved Islam becomes enacted entrustment within that settled order.

activation_trace.role: The opponents' severed hope marks their loss of leverage over the community's ordering principle.
Obedience and submission make the threefold dīn language an enacted authority relation.
Judgment and recompense add an accountability structure to the same repeated dīn.
Fear with awe supplies the explicit transfer of governing concern from them to Me.
Completion supplies the claim that the authority pattern now has all its necessary parts.
Full attainment makes favor operative rather than merely announced.
Approval rather than displeasure supplies the evaluative center of the selected order.
Handing over and entrusting the matter makes Islam an enacted relinquishment to that authority.

changed_reading.before: A proclamation that the religion has reached doctrinal completion.
changed_reading.after: A stabilization of allegiance in which judgment, fear, and entrusted action are redirected away from adversarial control and toward one governing authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding command to fulfill what is bound, immediately followed by selective loosening of animal restrictions, recasts the focus ruling as an architecture of fastening and release. Completion is coherence among obligations, permissions, prohibitions, and exceptions, not sheer accumulation of bans.

activation_trace.role: Fullness without deficiency supplies the demand that bound obligations be carried through completely.
Tying ends together supplies the material image for an internally connected legal order.
Binding and ratifying a covenant makes the connection normatively obligatory.
Untying a knot supplies the inverse operation by which a restriction is selectively released.
Dissolution of a prohibition identifies permission as an active legal operation.
The focus prohibition supplies the fastening operation that answers the preceding release.
Completion names the resulting coherence of tied and untied relations.

structural_cues: 5:1 orders fulfillment of contracts before alternating permission, exception, and sacred-state restriction.
5:3 continues that alternation with a prohibition list, a rescue exception, and the declaration of completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, untying, prohibition, and completion; I infer that these are coordinated legal operations whose fit constitutes completeness. A live alternative is that the knot imagery is only lexical and the rulings remain an unmodeled sequence.

changed_reading.before: Completion means that a final closed list of restrictions has been delivered.
changed_reading.after: Completion means a coherent covenantal pattern in which some relations are bound, others released, and exceptions preserve rather than defeat the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next food ruling distinguishes a predator that consumes for itself from a trained hunting agent that holds prey for the human eater under learned direction and naming. Admissibility therefore turns on governed agency and retained control, not on bare animal contact.

activation_trace.role: Prey prepared for eating supplies the focus problem of whose consumption has claimed the animal.
The predator supplies uncontrolled appetite as the initial disqualifying agent.
Completed slaughter supplies the focus's own means of recovering human-directed processing.
Knowledge made manifest through repeated teaching supplies transferable, learned direction.
A hunting animal supplies the same predatory capacity now placed inside a governed task.
Training dogs for hunting supplies deliberate formation of animal behavior.
Holding rather than consuming supplies retained custody for the human eater.
Voiced remembrance supplies explicit naming that aligns the captured food's ritual attribution.

structural_cues: 5:3 forbids what the predator ate except what humans complete by slaughter.
5:4 permits what trained hunting animals hold for the humans and couples eating with naming God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies predation, teaching, hunting, holding, and naming; I infer an arrow from trained restraint and retained custody to admissibility. A live alternative is that 5:4 gives a narrow hunting exception without establishing a general agency test.

changed_reading.before: Predator involvement itself contaminates the animal unless a last-moment slaughter occurs.
changed_reading.after: Ungoverned predatory consumption breaks custody, whereas trained, restrained, and named capture can carry human-directed agency through the predator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's hunger exception and the later no-water substitution share a purpose-preserving design. Material incapacity changes the required means, while non-deviating intent and purification preserve the end; completion of favor is therefore elastic enough to avoid constriction.

activation_trace.role: Compulsion supplies the focus case in which ordinary means cannot be maintained.
Bodily hunger supplies the concrete material incapacity requiring accommodation.
The focus's completed favor supplies the claim whose operational meaning is tested by the later substitution.
Constriction names the outcome the ritual substitution explicitly avoids.
Purity as removal of defilement supplies the stable end preserved across normal and substitute means.
Repeated full attainment directly links flexible purification to completion of favor.
Good condition and favor identify humane accommodation as a benefit rather than a defect.

structural_cues: 5:3 moves from prohibition to compelled hunger, an intent limit, and mercy.
5:6 moves from water-based purification to clean-earth substitution, then explicitly denies hardship and repeats completion of favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two incapacity cases, substitute means, no constriction, purity, and repeated completion; I infer that preserving the law's end causes its means to flex. A live alternative is that the two exceptions are independent domain-specific concessions.

changed_reading.before: A completed order is maximally fixed, with emergency relief added at its edge.
changed_reading.after: The order is complete partly because it preserves its ends under scarcity, changing means without licensing an intentional lean toward transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated today moves from completed dīn to reciprocal food permission and protected unions across a communal boundary. Completion behaves as a regulated interface: it can authorize exchange and durable relation without dissolving all distinctions.

activation_trace.role: The bounded day supplies the temporal marker for despair, completion, and favor.
Obedience supplies the communal ordering that the next day's permissions put into relation with others.
The repeated bounded day joins the permission sequence to the focus's completion sequence.
Repeated dissolution of prohibition actively opens selected cross-boundary relations.
Mutual food consumption supplies a two-way material exchange rather than one-way tolerance.
Protection by contract or inviolability supplies durable terms for intimate permeability.

structural_cues: The focus twice marks today around opponents' despair and completion of dīn.
5:5 opens with today and then states reciprocal food law and protected marriage relations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporal repetition, reciprocal food, and protected unions; I infer that completed identity enables governed permeability rather than requiring isolation. A live alternative is that today is repeated formulaically and the permissions are independent rulings.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition list seals communal identity by excluding contaminating external relations.
changed_reading.after: The completed order acts like a governed boundary that blocks specified processes while permitting reciprocal food and contracted intimacy across it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's transfer of fear is bracketed by repeated commands not to let hostility drive transgression or injustice. Completion therefore includes affective governance: fear and hatred may register danger, but they may not become the control signals for judgment.

activation_trace.role: Fear with awe supplies the focus's explicit reassignment of governing concern.
Hatred and enmity supply a strong external affect that could distort action.
Crossing the limit supplies the prohibited behavioral output of hostile affect.
Placing oneself in protection supplies an internal guard against reactive transgression.
Repeated hatred confirms that the affective pressure persists after the focus proclamation.
Equity supplies the public standard that hostile feeling must not displace.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the action preserved against hatred.
Nearness makes justice the movement toward protective God-consciousness rather than toward the enemy's pressure.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 repeat the same warning that hatred of a people must not cause wrongful action.
Between them, 5:3 says not to fear them but to fear Me and declares dīn complete.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostility, fear transfer, limit-crossing, and repeated justice commands; I infer that fear and hatred are rival control signals whose authority completion displaces. A live alternative is that the verses regulate separate emotions without a shared control mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Do not fear them is a call to courage after opponents lose hope.
changed_reading.after: The fear transfer is a discipline of judgment: external hostility cannot be allowed to author either legal boundaries or retaliatory conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later covenant failure supplies a grammar of broken transmission: undoing a binding, hardening, moving intelligible units from assigned places, and abandoning a share. This sharpens the focus food sequence as a provenance problem in which uncontrolled death, consumption, or rival dedication dislocates an item from its proper chain.

activation_trace.role: Carrion without slaughter supplies a material item whose proper transition was not completed.
Completion of slaughter supplies the focus's repair before the broken transition becomes final.
A confirmed covenant supplies the normative chain that later failure undoes.
Undoing what was firmly constructed supplies the governing image of broken continuity.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies a hardened medium that no longer transmits the covenant responsively.
Turning away from direction supplies the act that dislocates transmitted words.
An intelligible verbal unit supplies the item being carried through or displaced within transmission.
A thing's assigned place supplies the proper relational location from which distortion removes it.
Abandoning and neglecting supplies loss by failed custody rather than accidental absence.
An assigned share supplies what disappears when the transmission chain is neglected.

structural_cues: 5:7 recalls a confirmed covenant joined to hearing and obedience.
5:13 narrates breach as undoing, hardening, displacement from proper locations, and neglect of an assigned share.
The focus list repeatedly names interrupted deaths, consumed prey, misplaced dedication, and chance allocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covenant/textual failure chain and a food-handling sequence; I infer a cross-domain arrow from broken transmission to inadmissible provenance. A live alternative is that textual covenant breach and food processing remain unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: The forbidden animals are classified mainly by their physical causes of death.
changed_reading.after: Their physical causes become instances of broken custody and misplaced relation: admissibility depends on preserving or timely repairing a proper chain of handling, attribution, and share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later guidance sequence unfolds approval into following, multiple paths of peace, emergence from darkness, and a straight road. A completed dīn is thus complete as navigable guidance: sufficiently formed to carry continued movement rather than frozen as a static inventory.

activation_trace.role: Completion supplies the focus claim that the guiding order lacks no necessary part.
Obedience supplies the enacted movement by which the completed order is traversed.
Following behind supplies continued motion rather than static possession.
Approval repeats the focus's evaluative orientation and selects the direction followed.
Extended paths supply a plural, traversable guidance network.
Peace and reconciliation supply the condition toward which those paths carry the follower.
Passage to the outside supplies real transition from a confining prior state.
Illumination supplies the revealed field into which guided movement emerges.
The straight road supplies coherent direction within the completed order.

structural_cues: 5:3 joins completion, approval, Islam, and dīn.
5:16 turns approval into following and then into paths, emergence, light, and a straight road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion and a later movement sequence; I infer that the completed object functions causally as a route adequate for ongoing guidance. A live alternative is that completion is static while the route imagery belongs only to later revelation.

changed_reading.before: Completion closes the formation of a fixed religious object.
changed_reading.after: Completion makes the order fully traversable: it can continue carrying followers through differentiated paths toward peace and straightness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant senses of لحم as joining, textile weft, and kinship inside a literal meat prohibition. It remains anchored at the focus word and gains contextual support from contracts, reciprocal food, and protected unions; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material resonance, never as a replacement for the literal pork ruling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ within a ruling later joined to completed dīn.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated material supplies the possibility that eating law regulates how bodies and relations are attached.
Textile weft supplies a material model in which repeated food practices weave a communal fabric.
Kinship and clientage supply the social bonds potentially formed around shared embodiment.
Tying ends together supplies the contextual operation that turns isolated fibers into relation.
Reciprocal food consumption supplies the embodied practice through which groups materially meet.
Protected contractual union supplies a durable social join adjacent to reciprocal eating.

changed_reading.before: Flesh names only the edible substance being prohibited.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, flesh also resonates as social weft: rules of eating, exchange, and union regulate which embodied joins can be woven into communal life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain topology is surprising because it relates entry into the body to entry through a territorial gate. It remains anchored in the focus's spatial branch of حرم and its paired fear command, then receives a visible later sequence of holy place, gate, fear, victory, refusal, sitting, and spatial prohibition; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of disciplined thresholds, not claim that dietary and territorial rules are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُرِّمَتْ and فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ make boundary and directed fear explicit within the focus.

activation_trace.role: A protected spatial precinct supplies a topological branch inside the focus prohibition.
Fear with awe supplies the orientation required for disciplined action at a boundary.
A purified place supplies the later bounded destination that should be entered.
Returning away from the destination supplies reversal at the threshold.
Turning one's back supplies the bodily action of refusing entry.
Anticipatory fear supplies the pressure under which the gate decision is made.
A literal entrance supplies the later pericope's decisive threshold.
Overcoming force supplies the promised result of crossing under rightly governed fear.
Reliant trust supplies the alternative control principle to immobilizing fear.
Refraining from action supplies the community's chosen failure to cross.
The same spatial sanctuary branch now marks the destination as barred after refusal.

changed_reading.before: The focus governs only what may cross the bodily boundary as food.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its prohibition and fear transfer form a micro-topology of threshold obedience: rightly directed fear governs entry, while refusal can turn an offered protected domain into a barred one.

strongest_changes: Predator contact became an agency-and-custody test: trained restraint, holding, and naming can preserve admissibility where uncontrolled eating breaks it.
Completion became purpose-preserving flexibility because both hunger and no-water cases change means while guarding intention and the governing end.
The paired fear command became affective governance, preventing hostility from authoring transgression or injustice.
Repeated today plus reciprocal food and protected unions made completion a regulated interface rather than a sealed communal wall.
summary.what_was_special: The four-pericope window let the focus's food process interact with covenant binding, ritual substitution, justice under hostility, guided movement, and failed territorial entry without collapsing those activations into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The affiliation reading of ه ل ل depends on a form-distant mapped branch and should remain secondary to the clearer handling chain.
The broken-transmission and bodily-gate models rely on explicit cross-domain reader arrows; their mechanisms are visible but exploratory.
It remains uncertain whether the repeated today in 5:3 and 5:5 is one tightly joined temporal frame or parallel formulaic emphasis.
